steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen specified by the case.
Enable eRFX functionality required by the test company.
Allow the buyer to add a vendor during event creation.
Switch the initial event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title needed to publish.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the specified product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Verify that the requested product was added to the first sheet row.
Verify that the product’s variant auto-filled as Variant 1.
Verify the requested quantity.
Choose the required delivery location from the sheet dropdown.
Verify that the delivery location was selected.
Complete any remaining required pricing-sheet fields before scheduling.
Add one available QA test vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Open the Schedule Event drawer.
Verify that the schedule is using the Start now mode.
Choose the required 60-minute duration preset.
Record the end time shown by the schedule drawer for comparison after publishing.
Commit the schedule.
Verify that the saved schedule chip shows the 60-minute duration.
Publish the configured single-stage RFQ and confirm the publication dialog.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Verify that Project Details exposes the published bidding end time.
Compare the published Bidding Ends At value with the end time recorded in the schedule drawer.
